roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team members.In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for nursing staff, fostering continuous professional growth and competency. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, overseeing surveillance, prevention strategies, and compliance with regulatory guidelines. This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in staff development or nursing education.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in infection prevention and control within a healthcare setting.
Strong knowledge of current infection control practices and regulatory requirements (e.g., CDC, CMS).
Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.

description: Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) on a PRN basis. salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation for Physical Therapist Assistants is competitive, with full-time roles typically offering $28.00 - $37.00 per hour. PRN rates are determined based on experience and facility needs.

description:

description:
